KeysToEntries.Quest.Name: Icthlarin's Little Helper
KeysToEntries.Quest.Description: Slay the tyrant dragon Fuzan and unite the Moon Garou along the way
KeysToEntries.Icthlarin.Name: Icthlarin
KeysToEntries.Objective.FindGarou: Speak to the Alcarrid Elder in the Moon Garou settlement to the south
KeysToEntries.FirstGarou.Name: Shangruuh - Alcarrid Envoy
KeysToEntries.Objective.InvestigateGarouProblem: Investigate the nearby area for something that concerns the Moon Garou
KeysToEntries.Objective.ReturnToFirstGarou: Return to Shangruuh, the Alcarrid Envoy in the passage from Dowdun Reach
KeysToEntries.Objective.GatherThreeKeys: Travel to Moon Garou camps, find their elders, and earn their trust to gain their Mirror Lenses
KeysToEntries.Objective.GatherThreeKeys.1Found: Travel to Moon Garou camps, find their elders, and earn their trust to gain their Mirror Lenses
KeysToEntries.Objective.GatherThreeKeys.2Found: Travel to Moon Garou camps, find their elders, and earn their trust to gain their Mirror Lenses
KeysToEntries.Objective.FightFuzan: Enter the Fight Caves and defeat Fuzan
KeysToEntries.TribeBGarou.NotSpokenTo.Intro.1: My scouts saw your approach, my advisers told me you were coming, and my seers predicted your arrival. I doubt a Kalphite Queen would make a greater noise.
KeysToEntries.TribeA.Taskgiver2.Stay.1: Stay a while to trade, if you like.
KeysToEntries.TribeBGarou.SpokenTo.NoFavour.1: Could you complete your tasks a little quicker, and quieter, perhaps? And don't think that it will get you closer to my Mirror Lens.
KeysToEntries.Elder1.TasksComplete.4b: Your very own magic carpet, blessed by Moon Sprites.
KeysToEntries.Item.Description.Key.A: A Mirror Lens gained by completing tasks for the Alcarrid clan
KeysToEntries.Item.Description.Key.B: A Mirror Lens gained by completing tasks for the Uzzer clan
KeysToEntries.Item.Description.Key.C: A Mirror Lens gained by completing tasks for the Manafem clan
KeysToEntries.TribeBGarou.TasksComplete.1: My council have voted to reduce my powers. I am overruled.
KeysToEntries.MoonGarou.TribeB.Name: Gaimbín - Uzzer Elder
KeysToEntries.MoonGarou.TribeC.Name: Dúshlánach - Manafem Elder
KeysToEntries.Objective.ReturnToIcthlarin: Bring Fuzan's head to Icthlarin at the Mirror Relay
KeysToEntries.Item.FuzanHead.Description: It's tempting to leave it out in the Scorch to give it a taste of its own medicine.
KeysToEntries.TribeB.Taskgiver1.Intro.5: I want you to find each statue and note down the passages that are inscribed on them. Together, they will form a saga.
KeysToEntries.FristGarou.UmbralStart.Intro.3: I'd be very happy if you could travel to Alcarrid, my camp in the south-east. It was my job to bring an envoy from other regions.
KeysToEntries.Objective.Alcarrid.Elder: Speak to the Alcarrid Elder and complete tasks to earn their trust
KeysToEntries.FirstGarou.GarouCamp.NoReputation.JustSt: Mallacht! My first year as an elder, and I'm stuck between a dragon and a demi-god.
As convincing as Icthlarin is, it will not be enough for my people. They will not just bow to his whims.
My people do not trust the gods - that has gone badly for them. But you, adventurer: my Moon Garou could learn to trust you.
KeysToEntries.Objective.MakeFirstGarouCampLikeYou.NoFa: Gain the trust of the Alcarrid Camp
KeysToEntries.Objective.MakeFirstGarouCampLikeYou.LowF: Gain the trust of the Alcarrid Camp
KeysToEntries.Objective.MakeFirstGarouCampLikeYou.Mode: Gain the trust of the Alcarrid Camp
KeysToEntries.Objective.MakeFirstGarouCampLikeYou.High: You have completed the tribe's tasks. Return to the Alcarrid Elder
KeysToEntries.Objective.MakeFirstGarouCampLikeYou.MaxF: You have completed the tribe's tasks. Return to the Alcarrid Elder
KeysToEntries.Task.MaxFavourReached: You have already completed this task.
KeysToEntries.FirstGarou.GarouCamp.SomeReputation.LowR: You are still a stranger to my people, human. Talk with them! I appreciate that they may be fearsome to your eyes, but they are anything but.
KeysToEntries.FirstGarou.GarouCamp.SomeReputation.Medi: My people call you 'the one who watches'. It's better than 'the one who must be stabbed', I suppose. But you will need to help more if you want to earn their trust.
KeysToEntries.FirstGarou.GarouCamp.SomeReputation.High: My people call you 'meddlesome', which loses something in translation, I suspect. It is a good thing! Keep helping!
KeysToEntries.TribeA.Taskgiver2.Intro.1: I thought you might come to me. All of the camp is talking about the human and dog who want to take our Mirror Lens.
KeysToEntries.FirstGarou.GarouCamp.SomeReputation.Very: One more task should do it! I have seen the younger garou copying the way you walk, your posture. It is a good sign!
KeysToEntries.Objective.SpeakToIcthlarin: Speak to Icthlarin at the Mirror Relay
KeysToEntries.Icthlarin.NotStartedQuest: I wish to talk to you, adventurer. But could you first visit the garou at the passage to Dowdun Reach? It would aid us both if she was returned safely.
KeysToEntries.Icthlarin.QuestComplete: When you're the guardian of the Underworld, the word 'Legacy' takes on an odd meaning.
KeysToEntries.GarouElder.NotGotQuest: A human. How unbecoming. I hoped that we had moved far enough away from your sort.
KeysToEntries.GarouElder.NotMaxedOutFirstTribeFavour: Go curry favours with your Alcarrid friends. You are not wanted here.
KeysToEntries.TribeBGarou.NotSpokenTo.Intro.2: The Uzzer Clan are not the Alcarrid. We will not give up our Mirror Lens at the request of a half-god. Nor a human.
KeysToEntries.TribeBGarou.NotSpokenTo.Intro.3: I have better things to do. I am preparing for Mark Day. It is the day we accept Fuzan's Mark on our body and, with it, his protection.
KeysToEntries.TribeBGarou.SpokenTo.LowFavour.1: Oh, you are still here? I have heard whispers of your good deeds, but even those whispers are steeped in suspicion.
KeysToEntries.TribeBGarou.SpokenTo.MedFavour.1: I know what you are doing. You are not selfless! This is all for the Mirror Lens. While my council pushes me to deal with you, I will not!
KeysToEntries.TribeBGarou.SpokenTo.HighFavour.1: My council urge me to listen to you. Do you not see how precarious my position is? While my council pressure me, I am the one who has to deal with Fuzan. I beg you - stop making my life harder.
KeysToEntries.Player.TribeB.GotMaxFavour.1: You have completed the tribe's tasks. Return to the Uzzer Elder
KeysToEntries.Player.TribeC.GotMaxFavour.1: You have completed the tribe's tasks. Return to the Manafem Elder
KeysToEntries.PlayerChoice.Task3.Noble1.FactualArgumen: Fuzan's constant is control of others
KeysToEntries.Icthlarin.HasHead.Space.1: A formidable sight! I look forward to greeting Fuzan in the Underworld.
KeysToEntries.Icthlarin.HasHead.Space.2: You, though - I hope to greet many years hence. Although, my intuition tells me that you will be facing Fuzan's mother next.
KeysToEntries.Icthlarin.HasHead.NoSpace.1: Would you be so good as to clear space in your inventory? I have something you might want.
KeysToEntries.TribeA.Taskgiver.Task1.Name: Lagra - The Butcher
KeysToEntries.TribeA.Taskgiver.Task2.Name: Domri - The Merchant
KeysToEntries.TribeA.Taskgiver.Task3.Name: Valas - The Blacksmith
KeysToEntries.TribeB.Taskgiver.Task1.Name: Laguna - The Bard
KeysToEntries.TribeB.Taskgiver.Task2.Name: Lehran - The Archaeologist
KeysToEntries.TribeB.Task3.Noble1.GoodResponse.2: A reasonable hypothesis. There are no data points where Fuzan has constructed systems or edifices, rather than taken control of them.
KeysToEntries.TribeC.Taskgiver.Task1.Name: Manathep - The Bereaved
KeysToEntries.TribeC.Taskgiver.Task2.Name: Hedric - The Hunter
KeysToEntries.TribeC.Taskgiver.Task3.Name: Laguna - The Bard
KeysToEntries.TribeA.Taskgiver1.Intro.1: Lovely human! It is tasty that you see me. It delects my eyes to see you.
KeysToEntries.TribeA.Taskgiver1.CompletedTask.1: Your meats have sold like hot snakes! My wares have never been hotter and more desirable.
KeysToEntries.TribeA.Taskgiver2.Intro: I thought you might come to me. All of the camp is talking about the human and dog who want to take our Mirror Lens.
KeysToEntries.Elder1.TasksComplete.6: I have also persuaded our merchant to make more goods available to you. He was keeping the good stuff back from you.
KeysToEntries.TribeB.Taskgiver2.SpokenTo.GotScrolls.2: Luckily, there's nothing I like more than re-writing history books. This will keep me going for months!
KeysToEntries.TribeB.Taskgiver1.Intro.1: Good day. I am a bard, on the market for a business partner - one with survival skills.
KeysToEntries.TribeB.Taskgiver2.Intro: Ah, you'll be the one that's looking for the Mirror Lens. A rare fragment of history, that.
KeysToEntries.TribeB.Taskgiver2.CompletedTask.1: I am a Moon Garou of my word. You wanted my favour in trade for the moonstones, and I give it. My task is done. I shall also make my trading goods available to you.
KeysToEntries.TribeB.Taskgiver3.Intro.1: Why do the Uzzer garou have to be so insufferable? I came here to trade goods, but the Uzzer tribe are too busy planning for 'Fuzan Mark Day'.
KeysToEntries.TribeC.Taskgiver1.Intro.1: The Dearg Due! The Dearg Due! It killed my poor Efina!
KeysToEntries.TribeC.Taskgiver1.CompletedTask.1: Efina's alive? Efina's alive! Glory upon the River Goddess!
KeysToEntries.TribeC.Taskgiver2.Intro.1: There are always two kinds of people: the weak and the vultures. When someone is down, needing help, there's someone like you - hovering, waiting to pick from the carcass.
KeysToEntries.TribeC.Taskgiver3.Intro.1: Is it a mirage? A wondrous warrior has stepped in from the desert. My name is Laguna: the finest travelling bard this side of Kuldra's Tower.
KeysToEntries.TribeA.Taskgiver1.Intro.2: Human-tongue is not my first tongue. I am Moon Garou.
KeysToEntries.TribeA.Taskgiver1.Intro.3: But enough funny chin-waggling! You will help me with task. I am slicer and server of flesh for garou. I am butch.
KeysToEntries.TribeA.Taskgiver1.Intro.4: Bring me three raw farm meat, three kalphite shell fragments, and three cactus steaks from bunny cacti. Speak to me again if you want some clue!
KeysToEntries.TribeA.TaskGiver1.NotGotItems.1: I wait with breath bait! To remember, I want three raw farm meat, three kalphite shell fragments, and three cactus steaks from bunny cacti.
KeysToEntries.TribeA.TaskGiver1.GotAllItems.1: I smell your meats! Would you like to pass them to me?
KeysToEntries.TribeA.Taskgiver1.RefuseHandOver.1: There is no rush and I am patient. I am salted and pickled, so will not perish.
KeysToEntries.TribeA.Taskgiver1.HandedOverItems.1: I never seen flesh so moist and juicy! You have eye for dead tissue and exoskeletons.
KeysToEntries.TribeA.Taskgiver2.Intro.2: You need the tribe's trust, and I'm its trader. I connect everyone here. Thus, you need my good word.
KeysToEntries.TribeA.Taskgiver2.Intro.3: Well, it won't come easy. I want three moonstones: a gem that I have never personally held in my hand. They are so rare, in fact, that most Moon Garou will tell you that they don't exist.
KeysToEntries.TribeA.Taskgiver2.Intro.4: If you want my help with the Elder, you better hope they are incorrect. My guess is that they are to the west, hidden in rocky areas or caves. Under gypsum, maybe.
KeysToEntries.TribeA.Taskgiver2.SpokenTo.NoMoonstone.1: No moonstones? Goodness, have I given you an impossible task? What a tragedy. Perhaps you should cross your fingers and mine gypsum deposits to the west.
Now, don't take this the wrong way, but I had you followed. When you lost the moonstones, my partner re-acquired them. And what beauties they are.
I can scarcely believe it! Moonstones don't exist! I thought I was leading you on an impossible chase, yet - well, here they are.
I am a Moon Garou of my word. You wanted my favour in trade for the moonstones, and I give it. My task is done. I shall also make my trading goods available to you.
KeysToEntries.Moonstone.NoSpace: You don't have enough space in your inventory to take this moonstone. Return when you've cleared some of your quest items.
KeysToEntries.TribeA.Taskgiver3.Intro.1: You'll be the one who wants to remake the mirrors. Smells like folly to me, but I commend the spirit.
KeysToEntries.TribeA.Taskgiver3.Intro.2: Broken as they are, the mirrors are sacred to us. The River Goddess placed them here as a reminder of who must protect the Umbral Sands.
KeysToEntries.TribeA.Taskgiver3.Intro.3: But before we can add the Mirror Lenses, we must fix their frames. As you can see, they are mangled.
KeysToEntries.TribeA.Taskgiver3.Intro.4: Bring me three adamant bars to fix their frames. You can mine ore to make the bars at various mining spots to the south of here. You'll need to beware of kalphites, mind.
KeysToEntries.TribeA.Taskgiver3.Started.NotGotOres.1: The job isn't a small one. It will need three adamant bars. If you've forgotten, the ore is found in various places to the south of here.
KeysToEntries.TribeA.Taskgiver3.Started.HasOres.1: Right-ho, seems like you have the bars we need. If you don't mind, I'd like to do the work.
KeysToEntries.TribeA.Taskgiver3.Started.HasOres.Refuse: I've got other jobs I could be getting on with, you know.
KeysToEntries.TribeA.Taskgiver3.Started.HasOres.2: The mirror will be fixed before you get the Lenses. I'll inform the Elder of your part in getting the job done. It was nice meeting you.
KeysToEntries.TribeA.Taskgiver3.Started.PostQuest.1: The mirrors weren't just a symbol, you know. Back when this land was green and a lot less sandy, the River Goddess would use them.
KeysToEntries.TribeA.Taskgiver3.Started.PostQuest.2: How she would use them, I don't know. A historian would tell you more than a blacksmith. But I like to think she reflected her power across the land.
KeysToEntries.TribeB.Taskgiver1.Intro.3: There are four rocky spires around the pyramid, close to this camp. Each spire contains a statue.
KeysToEntries.TribeB.Taskgiver1.NotSpokenToElder.1: Goodness, you surprised me with your soft, noiseless feet. I may have a deal to propose, but you should talk to the Elder first.
KeysToEntries.TribeB.Taskgiver2.NotSpokenToElder.1: Oh no, no. There's a protocol in place for addressing the locals. You need to speak to the Elder first.
KeysToEntries.TribeB.Taskgiver2.Intro.1: Ah, you'll be the one that's looking for the Mirror Lens. A rare fragment of history, that.
KeysToEntries.TribeB.Taskgiver2.Intro.2: How about we help each other out? Historian to historian. You help me learn the truth about my ancestors, and I vouch for you with the Elder.
KeysToEntries.TribeB.Taskgiver2.Intro.3: There are some ruins far to the south, long lost to the sands. The KotHaar have stopped me from travelling there myself. It is said that beneath the sand are the Forbidden Scrolls. Four of them, in fact.
KeysToEntries.TribeB.Taskgiver2.Intro.4: Dig them up, with a spade, bring them to me and you will have your recommendation. Sound fair? I'll even share the revelations, if there are any.
KeysToEntries.TribeB.Taskgiver2.SpokenTo.NoScrolls.1: How's the digging going? If you need a reminder of where you're heading, it's the ruins to the far south. Dripping with KotHaar they are.
KeysToEntries.TribeB.Taskgiver2.SpokenTo.SomeScrolls.1: This is fascinating, but it makes little sense to me without all four Forbidden Scrolls. Come back when you have them all.
KeysToEntries.TribeB.Taskgiver2.SpokenTo.GotScrolls.1: Goodness, I can see why they were called Forbidden Scrolls! So much of Moon Garou history is based on outright lies.
KeysToEntries.TribeB.Taskgiver2.OptionalLink: Would you like to know more about the texts you uncovered?
KeysToEntries.Elder1.TasksComplete.4: It will bear you over quicksand. Navigating the sands will be a little easier.
KeysToEntries.Scroll.Name: Forbidden scroll
KeysToEntries.TribeB.Task2.FoundSpot: You have already found the ancient scroll that came from here.
KeysToEntries.Scroll1.Name: Forbidden Scroll - 'The Schism'
KeysToEntries.Scroll2.Name: Forbidden Scroll - 'Moon Goddess'
KeysToEntries.Scroll3.Name: Forbidden Scroll - 'Sun Demon'
KeysToEntries.Scroll4.Name: Forbidden Scroll - 'Old Kingdom'
KeysToEntries.Scroll1.Description: An ancient Moon Garou scroll describing the schism that separated the garou. An archaeologist will want this.
KeysToEntries.Scroll2.Description: An ancient garou scroll describing some kind of moon deity. An archaeologist will want this.
KeysToEntries.Scroll3.Description: An ancient garou scroll describing a cruel, sun-themed demoness. An archaeologist will want this.
KeysToEntries.Scroll4.Description: An ancient garou scroll describing old Moon Garou kingdom. An archaeologist will want this.
KeysToEntries.TribeB.Taskgiver3.Intro.3: They don't know how terrible, awful and painful the Mark is! At any moment, Fuzan could decide to puppet our bodies. Nobody should willingly get the Mark.
KeysToEntries.TribeB.Taskgiver3.SpokenTo.NoProgress.1: There are three nobles on the Council, and you'll need to convince them all to drop the Fuzan Festival thing. They're all out in the wider region, putting their heads in the sands.
KeysToEntries.PlayerChoice.TribeB.Task3.TellMeAboutNob: Tell me about the first councillor
Tell me about the second councillor
Tell me about the third councillor
KeysToEntries.TribeB.Taskgiver3.AskAboutNoble1.1: That will be Alabrais. He's a geologist. You'll find him wherever there are big rocks, in the direction of Fuzan's Volcano. He's a garou of logic, and his love is for science.
KeysToEntries.TribeB.Taskgiver3.AskAboutNoble2.1: That's Brialka, the historian. He'll be outside the Pyramid, north of here. He is the emotional type, loves his history, and will do anything to ensure a legacy for his people.
KeysToEntries.TribeB.Taskgiver3.AskAboutNoble3.1: Ugh, Chirot. He's a glorified graverobber, stealing treasures from the desert. He is as selfish as they get, only concerned about his wealth and interests. You'll find his camp to the south of here.
KeysToEntries.TribeB.Task3.Noble1.Intro.1: The name's Alabrais. If you wish to discuss Mark Day, could we make it quick? I am a man of science, not a man of the people, and I have rocks to study.
KeysToEntries.TribeB.Task3.Noble1.IncorrectAnswer.Emot: Emotional, non-scientific nonsense. Who is to say that the Mark is equivalent to enslavement?
KeysToEntries.PlayerChoice.Task3.Noble1.FactualArgumen: Fuzan's aim is to control you, like his KotHaar
KeysToEntries.PlayerChoice.Task3.Noble1.EmotionalArgum: You're enslaving your tribe to a psychopath
KeysToEntries.PlayerChoice.Task3.Noble1.DramaticArgume: Fuzan will burn Uzzer to cinders!
KeysToEntries.TribeB.Task3.Noble1.GoodResponse.1: I always assumed the KotHaar worked for Fuzan voluntarily. But that assumption is unverified. Interesting.
KeysToEntries.PlayerChoice.Task3.Noble1.FactualArgumen: There is only evidence that Fuzan destroys
KeysToEntries.PlayerChoice.Task3.Noble1.EmotionalArgum: You align with someone who brings suffering!
KeysToEntries.PlayerChoice.Task3.Noble1.DramaticArgume: Fuzan is just buttering you up
KeysToEntries.PlayerChoice.Task3.Noble1.EmotionalArgum: He's going to bring misery to your people!
KeysToEntries.PlayerChoice.Task3.Noble1.DramaticArgume: This will only end in death
KeysToEntries.TribeB.Task3.Noble1.IncorrectAnswer.Dram: An empty supposition. If Fuzan wanted us burned, we would be ash by now. Think scientifically, young one.
KeysToEntries.TribeB.Task3.Noble1.GoodResponse.3: You make a compelling argument. Both the KotHaar and the Mark show an orientation towards overbearing control. I will withdraw my support for the Mark Day.
KeysToEntries.TribeB.Task3.Noble2.Intro.1: The name's Brialka. I am a historian, and this - little human - is a Dragonkin Vault. Should you wish to discuss Mark Day, then I am more than happy to explain why I think it's best for our future.
KeysToEntries.TribeB.Task3.Noble2.IncorrectAnswer.Fact: What do you mean by control? I'm sure Fuzan has better things to do than puppet an optimistic little historian from Uzzer!
KeysToEntries.TribeB.Task3.Noble2.IncorrectAnswer.Dram: Let's not go overboard. I know many see me as an emotional historian, but I'm no fool. Fuzan hasn't burned us before, and he's unlikely to do it now.
KeysToEntries.PlayerChoice.Task3.Noble2.FactualArgumen: Fuzan will use the Mark to control you
KeysToEntries.PlayerChoice.Task3.Noble2.DramaticArgume: Fuzan will burn everyone into cinders!
KeysToEntries.PlayerChoice.Task3.Noble2.EmotionalArgum: You're making a choice that will affect generations
KeysToEntries.TribeB.Task3.Noble2.GoodAnswer.1: Oh my, what a good point you make! I'm not just making a decision for the living, I am making it for - perhaps - multitudes more.
KeysToEntries.PlayerChoice.Task3.Noble2.FactualArgumen: Your Elder is in league with Fuzan
KeysToEntries.PlayerChoice.Task3.Noble2.DramaticArgume: We need to take the fight to Fuzan!
KeysToEntries.PlayerChoice.Task3.Noble2.EmotionalArgum: A garou alliance would make us stronger
KeysToEntries.TribeB.Task3.Noble2.GoodResponse.2: You've done this debating thing before, haven't you? Yes, you are right - historically, the garou have been strongest together, and weakest apart.
KeysToEntries.PlayerChoice.Task3.Noble2.DramaticArgume: Now is the time to attack Fuzan
KeysToEntries.PlayerChoice.Task3.Noble2.EmotionalArgum: The garou have always united to survive
KeysToEntries.TribeB.Task3.Noble2.GoodResponse.3: Nothing brings people together like adversity. You are a convincing little human! You have my vote to cancel Mark Day.
KeysToEntries.TribeB.Task3.Noble1.Postquest: I have already withdrawn my support for the festival. The others may still support it though.
KeysToEntries.TribeB.Task3.Noble3.Intro.1: Chirot's the name! Always happy to meet someone new, particularly if they have coin in their purse, or goods to fence. But why do I think you're here to talk about Mark Day rather than profit?
KeysToEntries.PlayerChoice.Task3.Noble3.FactualArgumen: The Mark won't stop Fuzan hurting people
KeysToEntries.PlayerChoice.Task3.Noble3.EmotionalArgum: Mark Day commits everyone to servitude
KeysToEntries.PlayerChoice.Task3.Noble3.SelfishArgumen: Fuzan's actions have cost you money
KeysToEntries.TribeB.Task3.Noble3.IncorrectChoice.Emot: Oh boo hoo. There is always a hierarchy - people on the top, people on the bottom. Maybe you're just resentful that you're not on top, like me.
KeysToEntries.TribeB.Task3.Noble3.IncorrectChoice.Fact: Boring! Everyone can be bought. If anyone threatens me, I tuck some gems into their belt.
KeysToEntries.TribeB.Task3.Noble3.IncorrectChoice.Dram: Oh bravo, very dramatic. But drama won't make me rich, will it?
KeysToEntries.TribeB.Task3.Noble3.GoodResponse.1: True, true. His raids have done a lot of damage to my business so far. But gaining Fuzan's protection will stop all that, won't it?
KeysToEntries.PlayerChoice.Task3.Noble3.FactualArgumen: You'll be his servants, till he grows tired of you
KeysToEntries.PlayerChoice.Task3.Noble3.DramaticArgume: Fuzan brings doom to the garou
KeysToEntries.PlayerChoice.Task3.Noble3.SelfishRespons: Before or after Fuzan takes his cut?
KeysToEntries.TribeB.Task3.Noble3.GoodResponse.2: A cut! A CUT! He wouldn't, would he? Well, I will just have to swindle more to make up for it.
KeysToEntries.PlayerChoice.Task3.Noble3.EmotionalRespo: How can you think about money?
KeysToEntries.PlayerChoice.Task3.Noble3.DramaticRespon: No-one will be trading if they're in fear
KeysToEntries.PlayerChoice.Task3.Noble3.SelfishRespons: Fuzan will steal what you wish to steal
KeysToEntries.TribeB.Task3.Noble3.GoodResponse.3: You're right! Only Chirot gets to steal from his fellow garou! I am withdrawing my support for the festival. You can tell the Elder that I'm having none of it.
KeysToEntries.TribeB.Task3.Noble2.IncorrectAnswer.Dram: The young are so exciting to watch! But history tells me that open rebellion is more dangerous than any Mark Day.
KeysToEntries.TribeB.Taskgiver3.SpokenTo.GatheredSuppo: Best news I've heard all week! Not only has Fuzan Mark Day been cancelled, but the Elder's powers have been reduced! You're one step closer to the Mirror Lens.
KeysToEntries.TribeB.Task3.Noble1.Name: Alabrais - Science Councillor
KeysToEntries.TribeB.Task3.Noble2.Name: Brialka - Historian Councillor
KeysToEntries.TribeB.Task3.Noble3.Name: Chirot - Broker Councillor
KeysToEntries.MirageBeast.Name: Dearg Due
KeysToEntries.TribeC.Taskgiver1.Intro.2: Efina was taken three days ago, and every night the Dearg Due has been watching me from the south of the camp with a glint in her eye and blood on her lips. She be gloating!
KeysToEntries.TribeC.Taskgiver1.Intro.3: The Dearg Due is a wicked beast. Lures you into the sands then snaps your bones. Oh, Efina!
KeysToEntries.TribeC.Taskgiver1.SpokenTo.1: Please, we will get no peace until the Dearg Due is dead. It watches us from the south of the camp. Kill it, then find my Efina's remains.
KeysToEntries.TribeC.Task3.InjuredGarou.Name: Efina - The Lost
KeysToEntries.TribeC.Task1.InjuredGarou.Intro.1: I am so lost... the sand it... it obscured everything.  Water, please, do you have any clean water?
KeysToEntries.TribeC.Task1.InjuredGarou.RefuseWater.1: Have mercy, I'll die without water. Please help.
KeysToEntries.TribeC.Task1.InjuredGarou.GiveWater.1: I can feel the strength coming back to me. Thank you.
KeysToEntries.TribeC.Task1.InjuredGarou.GiveWater.2: I ran away from Manafem. I couldn't do it any more: the Mark, the overbearing sadness, my mum keeping watch over me every waking hour.
KeysToEntries.TribeC.Task1.InjuredGarou.PostQuest.1: Don't worry, I'm safe and healthy. I'm just making the hardest choice of my life.
KeysToEntries.TribeC.Taskgiver1.CompletedTask.2: Well, if the beast didn't kill Efina, then it must have tricked her. Efina wouldn't go into the desert alone.
KeysToEntries.TribeC.Taskgiver1.CompletedTask.3: I can barely wait for my Efina to come back. And don't you worry - I'll tell the Elder all about what you done for me.
KeysToEntries.TribeC.Taskgiver2.Intro.3: You want to prove that you're not? Hmmm. Well, my latest scouting party have gone missing, on the trail of a creature that has been picking off my people, one by one.
KeysToEntries.Dragon.Name: The Radiant - Lesser Red Dragon
KeysToEntries.DragonHeart.Name: The Radiant's Heart
KeysToEntries.Dragonheart.Description: The heart of an unpleasant red dragon, still smouldering. Hedric - The Hunter will want to see this.
KeysToEntries.TribeC.Taskgiver2.GotHeart.1: You killed the creature already? If it was a dragon of that size, I fear my scouts are dead. The Manafem are strong, but not that strong.
KeysToEntries.TribeC.Taskgiver2.Postquest.1: We have one fewer thing to fear. Thank you.
KeysToEntries.TribeC.Taskgiver3.Intro.PlayerHasMet.1: If it isn't the Dreamboat of the Desert! The ancient saga we recovered together has been getting me a lot of attention. And I mean a LOT.
KeysToEntries.TribeC.Taskgiver3.Intro.2: I need your help with something, if you would. My great-great-grandfather was a shaman, and I came here to learn more about him. Perhaps write a song in his honour.
KeysToEntries.TribeC.Taskgiver3.Intro.3: But the Manafem garou are less than helpful. They say 'everything I need to know is in the Vault'.
KeysToEntries.TribeC.Taskgiver3.Intro.4: They say that his children wrote a song about him? It's inscribed onto three statues within a pyramid-like vault, somewhere to the south.
KeysToEntries.TribeC.Task3.Statue1.1:
"Five cradles stood empty on that baleful night,
A monster claimed them, and then took flight.
It left no footprints or scent on the air,
All the garou could follow was a thread of despair."
KeysToEntries.TribeC.Task3.Statue2.1:
"A shaman journeyed on the garous’ behalf.
Moon sprites twinkling on his adamant staff.
Kalphite skittered with a twist of his wrist.
Till the monster approached. “Shaman, desist.” "
KeysToEntries.TribeC.Task3.Statue3.1:
“A staff will not kill me. Ha - it’ll take more than that!
I have something to trade for your five little cats.
Their young minds are worthless. I need something older.
I’ll take what’s in your hand, and what's on your shoulder.”
KeysToEntries.TribeB.Taskgiver2.ScrollResponse.4: This Forbidden Scroll debunks the theory that ancient garou just disappeared in Umbral Sands.
KeysToEntries.TribeB.Taskgiver2.ScrollResponse.3: This Forbidden Scroll talks about the Sun Demon, but suggests she arrived reasonably recently.
KeysToEntries.Statue.Found: You have already transcribed these lyrics.
KeysToEntries.Statue.Name: Ancient Garou Statue
KeysToEntries.TribeC.Taskgiver3.CompletedQuest.1: You've found them all! Deeeelightful. Let me weave them into verse.
KeysToEntries.TribeC.Taskgiver3.CompletedQuest.3: It does make me wonder. Perhaps I am not descended from the shaman, and am - instead - descended from one of the children he saved.
KeysToEntries.TribeC.Taskgiver3.PostQuest.1: It's time to move on, I feel. I wonder if the Alcarrid tribe are more my vibe.
KeysToEntries.TribeA.Taskgiver1.NotSpokenToElder: Delicious to view you, but Alcarrid Elder says that visitors must see him first.
KeysToEntries.TribeA.Taskgiver2.NotSpokenToElder: If you want to trade, you'll need to speak to the Elder first. There is an order to these things.
KeysToEntries.TribeA.Taskgiver3.NotSpokenToElder: You'll be wanting to talk to the Elder, not me.
KeysToEntries.TribeC.taskgiver1.NotSpokenToElder: I'm beside myself! Please, talk to the Elder then come back to me after. I have need of you.
KeysToEntries.TribeC.taskgiver2.NotSpokenToElder: Move along, human. Head to the Elder if you plan on sticking around.
KeysToEntries.TribeC.taskgiver3.NotSpokenToElder: We have much to talk about, but everyone is staring. I think you need to visit the Elder before we discuss.
KeysToEntries.TribeB.Taskgiver2.ScrollResponse.2: This Forbidden Scroll shines a light on the real Moon and River Goddess.
KeysToEntries.TribeB.Taskgiver2.Intro3b: The Forbidden Scrolls are said to contain the truth about the Moon Garou. Not what we have been fed by our Elders: what actually happened, many centuries ago.
KeysToEntries.Shangruuh.Intro.1: I don't know much about humans, but you don't look like a Black Knight. I guess I'll give the prepared speech anyway.
KeysToEntries.Shangruuh.Intro.2: I COME HERE ON BEHALF OF THE MOON GAROU OF ALCARRID. WE SEEK AN ALLIANCE AGAINST THE DRAGON FUZAN.
KeysToEntries.Shangruuh.Intro.3: So, not-a-Black-Knight, are you going to help us?
KeysToEntries.Shangruuh.Intro.4: Well, that went better than I expected. You will need to travel south-east to Alcarrid, our camp, where your alliance will be processed.
KeysToEntries.Shangruuh.Intro.5: And stay in the shadows as much as you can. The Umbral Sands is plagued by something called Scorch. The sun gives no leeway to unprepared humans.
KeysToEntries.Shangruuh.Intro.Denied.1: That's...unfortunate. If and when you change your mind, come to my camp in Alcarrid and talk to the Elder.
KeysToEntries.Icthlarin.Elder.Conversation.1: Icthlarin, I am not disagreeing with you. But we are a young clan, only a few years old. We have barely learnt to survive in the desert. We aren't ready to confront a dragon!
KeysToEntries.Icthlarin.Elder.Conversation.2: Elder, with all respect, I am not asking you to face Fuzan. Leave that to me. I am merely asking for your clan's Mirror Lens.
KeysToEntries.Icthlarin.Elder.Conversation.3: And what then? You use this Mirror Relay to blast Fuzan's Volcano, and he flies here in a rage. We are not warriors! You cannot do that to my people.
KeysToEntries.Icthlarin.Elder.Conversation.4: You are the God of the Underworld. I know how this works. We couldn't stop you from taking our Mirror Lens. But please, earn the trust of my people before you condemn them.
KeysToEntries.Icthlarin.Elder.Conversation.5: Ah, impeccable timing. Hello adventurer. It seems that the Elder here and I are at a standstill. How do you feel about earning the trust of this clan so that we can gain their Mirror Lens?
KeysToEntries.Player.Choice.Icthlarin.No.Reply: Do not dilly-dally, mortal. The tyrant Fuzan will kill all of the garou in Umbral Sands. They do not know it yet, but that day is coming soon.
KeysToEntries.Icthlarin.Quest.Accepted.1: I am in your debt, adventurer, which is no mean thing. As the God of the Underworld, that could be rather handy.
KeysToEntries.Icthlarin.Quest.Accepted.2: My plan is to complete the Mirror Relay you see next us. Once all three Mirror Lenses are united, the Relay will fire a beam at the dragon Fuzan's Volcano. From there, we can slay the dragon.
KeysToEntries.Icthlarin.Quest.Accepted.3: But that job is for tomorrow. Today, we earn the trust of this clan. My jackal-head tends to make me seem untrustworthy. But if you complete these tasks for this clan, the Elder will relent.
KeysToEntries.Elder1.Name: Ancamairon - Alcarrid Elder
KeysToEntries.Elder1.NoQuest.1: Welcome to Alcarrid. I am afraid I am engaged as current, so please come back later.
KeysToEntries.Elder1.Beat2.1: We hoped we might be safer, moving further away from the dragon Fuzan. For a while that was true.
KeysToEntries.Elder1.Beat2.2: But he has been making raids around the camp, and his KotHaar have been making demands of our goods.
KeysToEntries.Elder1.Beat2.3: But that doesn't mean that we can just take the fight to Fuzan. History tells us that resisting the dragons has not gone well.
KeysToEntries.FirstGarou.GarouCamp.NoReputation.JustSt: Please, help my people with any tasks they may have. Only then will my people accept your request to hand over our Mirror Lens.
KeysToEntries.Elder1.TasksComplete.1: You have earned the Alcarrid clan's trust. Our butcher has even named a new dish after you!
KeysToEntries.Elder1.TasksComplete.2: We have held council, and agreed to give you the clan's Mirror Lens. Ach, I hope we do not regret it.
KeysToEntries.Elder1.TasksComplete.3: If you don't mind, I also wish to give you a personal gift. My partner is a weaver, and she has made you something.
KeysToEntries.Elder1.Beat4.1: How are you finding the magic carpet? Beats getting sucked into quicksand, am I right?
KeysToEntries.Elder1.Beat4.2: Feel free to stay a while. The other clans are still reluctant to trade with us, so we could do with the business.
KeysToEntries.Elder1.Beat5.1: I can't quite believe it: you have the trust and Mirror Lenses of Uzzer, Manafem AND Alcarrid? Not even Fuzan could bring the three clans together!
KeysToEntries.Elder1.Beat5.2: Now for the part that scares me to the marrow of my bones. I dearly hope you can slay Fuzan.
KeysToEntries.Elder1.Beat6.1: Our clan is only a few years old, so we haven't had time to form our own myths or heroes.
KeysToEntries.Elder1.Beat6.2: But you can bet that the gossips and storytellers of Alcarrid are going to claim you as one of their own!
KeysToEntries.Elder1.Beat6.3: The Dragon Slayer of Alcarrid. A fine title.
KeysToEntries.TribeBGarou.TasksComplete.2: You have earned their trust - more trust than they have in me, it seems. They have even allowed you to purchase more desirable goods from the merchants.
KeysToEntries.TribeBGarou.TasksComplete.3: Mark Day is cancelled. We will not submit to Fuzan.
KeysToEntries.TribeBGarou.TasksComplete.4: And the Mirror Lens is yours. Please, understand the responsibility you are taking on. If you fail to defeat Fuzan, we die. All of us, to a whisker.
KeysToEntries.TribeBGarou.Return.1: Please, stay a while in Uzzer. Our traders are unparalleled.
KeysToEntries.TribeBGarou.Beat5.1: For all of our sakes, I hope you kill Fuzan. If you fail, then it is over. We are damned.
KeysToEntries.TribeBGarou.Beat6.1: I do not give praise lightly, but you are remarkable. Killing Fuzan has lifted a great weight from the Uzzer, a weight that we did not know that we were carrying.
KeysToEntries.TribeCGarou.Beat1.1: Be off with you, Unmarked. Manafem lives are hard enough without prying human eyes.
KeysToEntries.TribeCGarou.Beat3.1: Do you not have an Alcarrid garou to pester? I can think of a million things I need to deal with more than you.
KeysToEntries.TribeCGarou.Intro.1: You are a bad omen at a bad time, Unmarked.
KeysToEntries.TribeCGarou.Intro.2: We bear the Mark of Fuzan, and it is a wound that carves deep.
KeysToEntries.TribeCGarou.Intro.3: We may not look like we are bleeding, but each day we lose hope, sanity and fight. It pours and clots into the sand of Manafem.
KeysToEntries.TribeCGarou.Intro.4: But our pride does NOT bleed out. While we might need help, we are reluctant to accept it. You will have a tough time earning our trust with tasks, Unmarked.
KeysToEntries.TribeCGarou.SpokenTo.NoFavour.1: Are you struggling to earn our trust, Unmarked? It is not gained easily. We have been cheated so often that we expect it.
KeysToEntries.TribeCGarou.SpokenTo.LowFavour.1: Thank you for helping that garou. But it will take more than that to win over my wary people.
KeysToEntries.TribeCGarou.SpokenTo.MediumFavour.1: I saw some labourers making jokes together! Do you know how rare that is? Keep going - I might even see one of them smile.
KeysToEntries.TribeCGarou.SpokenTo.HighFavour.1: There is a phrase that our River Goddess taught us: 'to have a spring in your step'. That is how it feels to be a Manafem right now, Unmarked. Complete one more task and the Mirror Lens is yours.
KeysToEntries.TribeCGarou.TasksComplete.1: Can I tell you something, Unmarked? Being a Manafem Elder is a punishment, not an honour. More garou turn it down than accept it.
KeysToEntries.TribeCGarou.TasksComplete.2: As Elder, you must face Fuzan. You must meet his KotHaar envoys. Your Mark burns most when the clan fails him. And he is not easy to please...
KeysToEntries.TribeCGarou.TasksComplete.3: For the first time, being Elder of the Manafem has been an honour. You have vindicated my choice to let you into Manafem. You have vindicated it tenfold.
KeysToEntries.TribeCGarou.TasksComplete.4: Take our Mirror Lens. Use it to burn a hole through Fuzan. Let the River Goddess's light pierce him.
KeysToEntries.TribeCGarou.CompleteReturn.1: You have a good heart, Unmarked. Manafem is lucky that you visited us.
KeysToEntries.TribeCGarou.Beat5.1: Fuzan's Mark burns more than ever. He has focused the Lens on us, I can feel it. Please - claim his head before he decides to claim us completely.
KeysToEntries.TribeCGarou.Beat6.1: Sweet, blessed River Goddess, the pain of Fuzan's Mark has gone.
KeysToEntries.TribeCGarou.Beat6.2: It's like I am seeing the world afresh. My senses haven't been dulled by pain. Has the wind always made that whistling sound through our camp?
KeysToEntries.TribeCGarou.Beat6.3: Unmarked, I have more thanks than there are grains of sand in Umbral.
KeysToEntries.TribeCGarou.Beat6.4: And listen to me, calling you Unmarked! We are all Unmarked. Ah, the words feel so good in my mouth!
KeysToEntries.Mirror.Desc.1: A mirror frame with a missing lens
KeysToEntries.Mirror.Prompt.1: Ichlarin will want to talk to you about this first.
KeysToEntries.Fuzan.Gate.Desc.1: The door remains magically sealed shut.
KeysToEntries.Fuzan.Gate.Desc.2: A large volcanic cave entrance lies before you.
KeysToEntries.FightCaves.Warning.1: Fuzan's voice shakes the foundations of the volcano.
KeysToEntries.FightCaves.Warning.2: A challenger comes knocking! Well, who am I to turn a guest away? Especially one who melts my Lens with fancy mirrors.
KeysToEntries.FightCaves.Warning.3: We shall start with some entertainment: you versus the KotHaar of my Fight Caves.
KeysToEntries.FightCaves.Warning.4: Be warned: once you initiate the Fight Caves, you will not be able to leave until the fight is completed.
KeysToEntries.FightCaves.Exit.1: A large volcanic exit stands before you.
KeysToEntries.FightCaves.Exit.No.1: You can't exit the Fight Caves while the challenge is still in progress.
KeysToEntries.Fuzan.Gate.Approach.1: Fuzan's voice is louder, if that is possible.
KeysToEntries.Fuzan.Gate.Approach.2: I have been watching you, meddler. Have you come to complete my tasks?
KeysToEntries.Fuzan.Gate.Approach.3: No, I think not. I think you have come to die.
KeysToEntries.Fuzan.Gate.Approach.4: This will not be an easy fight. Prepare yourself for battle.
KeysToEntries.Fuzan.Challenge.Complete.1: Congratulations! You have completed the Fight Caves.
KeysToEntries.Fuzan.Challenge.Complete.2: The KotHaar stand down, allowing you passage to Fuzan's Gate.
KeysToEntries.Icthlarin.QuestComplete.2: The dead fret about legacy. They worry about what they have left behind. I've never understood why. It means nothing to me.
KeysToEntries.Icthlarin.QuestComplete.3: But the Moon Garou, Umbral Sands: this is my mother Elidinis's legacy. She nurtured something that was meant to grow. This place grew in her image, and it IS her, in so many ways.
KeysToEntries.Icthlarin.QuestComplete.4: We have preserved her legacy. And now I know what the word truly means. When the dead talk about what they left behind, I think I will understand a little better.
KeysToEntries.Icthlarin.Intro.1: I wish we could meet on better terms, adventurer. My name is Icthlarin, God of the Underworld.
KeysToEntries.Icthlarin.Intro.2: Souls are coming to me from Umbral Sands at a faster and faster rate. My good friend Death informed me that the culprit is Fuzan, a dragon tyrant of these dunes.
KeysToEntries.Icthlarin.Intro.4: It is time to push back, and there is no better weapon than this Mirror Relay. It is lacking three Mirror Lenses but, once complete, it could concentrate a light beam on Fuzan's Volcano.
KeysToEntries.Icthlarin.Intro.5: You have done so much good in these veiled lands. I beg you to do some more. Could you talk to the Alcarrid Elder, earn the trust of his people, and gain their Mirror Lens?
KeysToEntries.Icthlarin.Intro.6: We would only need two more to complete the Relay. But it would be a mighty step towards slaying Fuzan!
KeysToEntries.Icthlarin.Beat3.Done.1: Quite the busybody. You seem to have earned their trust. I would speak to the Elder.
KeysToEntries.Icthlarin.Beat3.NotDone.1: Ugh, democracy is such a tiresome mortal concept. While we have convinced the Elder to hand over the Lens, it seems that we also have to convince his people.
KeysToEntries.Icthlarin.Beat3.NotDone.2: This job suits you better than me. Earn Alcarrid's trust by completing tasks in the camp.
KeysToEntries.Icthlarin.Beat4.Done.1: You are really quite effective. The garou are looking at us with less than the traditional amount of disgust.
KeysToEntries.Icthlarin.Beat4.Done.2: We have one Mirror Lens, but alas there are three empty mirror frames here.
KeysToEntries.Icthlarin.Beat4.Done.3: The final two Mirror Lenses will be held by the remaining Moon Garou camps: Uzzer to the east and Manafem to the south.
KeysToEntries.Icthlarin.Beat4.Done.4: Your magic carpet will get a lot of use, I suspect. But that journey is for you, not me. I must stay here and guard the Mirrors. Fuzan will no doubt focus his efforts on them. They are the easier target.
KeysToEntries.Icthlarin.Beat5.2: But more importantly, Fuzan's Lens has been destroyed. It no longer provides protection around the Volcano. Fuzan is exposed.
KeysToEntries.Icthlarin.Beat5.3: We must hurry. It is time to strike Fuzan before he retaliates. But I must warn you: he will use his KotHaar as a shield. You will likely need to face waves of them before confronting Fuzan.
KeysToEntries.Icthlarin.Beat5.4: But you should be prepared regardless. There are more than just dragons in there, and the threat will be greater than anything you have seen before.
KeysToEntries.Icthlarin.Beat5.NotDone.1: There is little time to waste, adventurer. We must repair the mirrors.
KeysToEntries.Icthlarin.Beat5.NotDone.2: I have positioned them carefully. I believe that they are directed towards Fuzan's Lens: the dragonkin relic which both protects his Volcano and powers Fuzan's Mark.
KeysToEntries.Icthlarin.Beat5.NotDone.3: That belief is about to be tested when you complete the Mirrors. Elidinis help me if I am wrong.
KeysToEntries.Icthlarin.HasHead.Space.3: Someone that foolhardy should go prepared. And to that end, I have a gift for you.
KeysToEntries.Icthlarin.HasHead.Space.4: Part trophy, part defensive item, part Mirror Lens. I have put a fragment of my mother's mirror in there.
KeysToEntries.Objective.PlaceMirrorLenses: Place the three Mirror Lenses into the Mirror Relay
KeysToEntries.Objective.FightCaves: Journey through the Fight Caves and slay Fuzan
KeysToEntries.TribeA.Taskgiver1.HandedOverItems.2: I give you my succulent trust for making friends with Alcarrid.
Know this: I could have kept the moonstones and mentioned nothing to you. I did this as a favour. Someday, and that day may never come, I will call upon you to do a service for me.
KeysToEntries.TribeB.Taskgiver2.SpokenTo.GotScrolls.3: I will petition the Elder to give you the Mirror Lens. And should you be curious, you can return to me and find out what was written in the Forbidden Scrolls.
KeysToEntries.TribeB.Taskgiver3.NotSpokenToElder.1: Good to see you. Go talk to the Uzzer Elder: you won't believe what they have to say for themselves.
KeysToEntries.TribeB.TaskGiver3.Intro.5: The Elder won't change their mind, but the Council might. Please, find Uzzer's councillors near the landmarks of this region. Persuade them that Fuzan Mark Day is the most terrible of terrible ideas.
KeysToEntries.TribeB.Task3.Noble1.IncorrectAnswer.Emot: The world is a complicated place, young one. Like in geology, sometimes soft rock aligns with hard. I cannot agree with you.
Many garou will say they are miserable already! Things are relative, young one. You must consider proportional value in your scientific studies.
KeysToEntries.TribeB.Task3.Noble1.IncorrectAnswer.Dram: You certainly use imaginative imagery! But imagery has little value to a garou of science.
Promises almost never hold, young one. As a bond, it is one of the weakest. You will need a more scientifically proven argument than that.
KeysToEntries.TribeB.Task3.Noble2.IncorrectAnswer.Dram: And have the blood of hundreds, perhaps thousands of garou on our hands? History would not be kind to us if that were the case.
KeysToEntries.TribeB.Task3.Noble2.IncorrectAnswer.Fact: I must stop you there! The Elder is strong-willed but trustworthy. Nothing in his history points to betrayal, and history is what I care about.
If we dismantle governments every time a mistake is made, then how would we ever learn? History would repeat itself.
KeysToEntries.TribeB.Task3.Noble3.IncorrectChoice.Dram: The most powerful rise to the top. They always do. There is plenty of room for Fuzan at the top and Chirot slightly underneath.
KeysToEntries.TribeB.Task3.Noble3.IncorrectChoice.Emot: How can I NOT think about money? Coins have two sides: power and influence. I love them both.
KeysToEntries.TribeB.Task3.Noble3.IncorrectChoice.Dram: You misunderstand the mortal condition, my friend. There is always money to be made, ESPECIALLY when things are bad.
KeysToEntries.TribeB.Merchant.Intro.1: I have wares, if you wish to trade?
KeysToEntries.TribeB.Merchant.NotSpokentoElder.1: Speak with the Elder before I trade with you.
KeysToEntries.TribeB.Merchant.Name: Iasadair - The Merchant
KeysToEntries.TribeC.Taskgiver1.Intro.4: You have to kill it! Kill the Dearg Due! Go south where it prowls, an' make sure it never kills another. Then, please, bring back my Efina's body.
KeysToEntries.TribeC.Task1.InjuredGarou.GiveWater.3: Tell mum that I'm safe, that I'm on my way back. It may be the truth, it may not. I have a decision to make.
KeysToEntries.TribeC.Task1.InjuredGarou.GiveWater.4: Whichever way I am heading - thank you. And thanks to you, Dearg Due. I was brought up to fear you, but I know now that was wrong.
KeysToEntries.TribeC.Taskgiver2.Intro.4: Find my scouts, then help them track down the beast. Bring me its heart - if it has one. Do that, and I might think twice about you. They should be somewhere off to the east.
KeysToEntries.TribeC.Taskgiver2.Return.1: Must I repeat myself? Find my scouts to the east, and help them to track the beast then take its heart. I'm confident they are somewhere to the east.
KeysToEntries.TribeC.Taskgiver2.GotHear.2: Still, that dragon will have been small-fry compared to Fuzan. I hope you know what you're doing. Regardless, I have given my recommendation to the Elder.
KeysToEntries.TribeC.Taskgiver3.Intro.5: Would you go there and write down the lyrics on the statues? I would go myself, but it's said that there are beetles in the vault. And you know... ick.
KeysToEntries.TribeC.Taskgiver3.Return.1: Where did I send you again? Oh yes: head south to the Vault and look for lyrics carved into statues. Just watch out for beetles!
KeysToEntries.TribeC.Taskgiver3.CompletedQuest.4: Sigh. I guess I will never know. I'm not sure what good it will do you, but I will vouch for you to the Manafem Elder.
KeysToEntries.TribeC.Merchant.Intro.1: I have wares, if you have trade?
KeysToEntries.TribeC.Merchant.NotSpokentoElder.1: Speak with the Elder before I trade with you.
KeysToEntries.TribeC.Merchant.Name: Beartach - The Merchant
KeysToEntries.TribeB.Taskgiver2.GarouSchism.1: It is no secret that the schism was a defining moment for my people. The garou were once united under a single banner. We served under Lougrim, goddess of the moon.
KeysToEntries.TribeB.Taskgiver2.GarouSchism.2: According to our traditions, we had the rite of challenge: anyone who could best the current monarch became ruler of the tribe. Lougrim challenged all the elders, becoming the High Queen of the Garou.
KeysToEntries.TribeB.Taskgiver2.GarouSchism.3: Kuldra, the dragon queen and source of most of our problems, challenged Lougrim. Current garou history tells that this was a fair fight. Skill versus skill, might versus might. But according to the scroll, this was a lie!
KeysToEntries.TribeB.Taskgiver2.GarouSchism.4: The challenge wasn't issued at all! Lougrim had spent almost of all of her power shielding villages from dragonfire. Wounded and weak, Kuldra descended on her without mercy and simply devoured her.
KeysToEntries.TribeB.Taskgiver2.GarouSchism.5: Kuldra declared herself queen and, out of fear, many garou followed her. But not us. Not those who would become Moon Garou. We refused to submit and fled our homes in search of a land free from Kuldra's cruelty.
KeysToEntries.TribeB.Taskgiver2.GarouSchism.6: I wonder why the truth of that moment was considered forbidden?
KeysToEntries.TribeB.Taskgiver2.MoonGoddess.1: Our people have always felt connected with the moon. There is something about its silver light that brings a sense of peace that's hard to describe to non-garou.
KeysToEntries.TribeB.Taskgiver2.MoonGoddess.2: It's no surprise, then, that we favour deities of the moon. Our first was Lougrim, a goddess of the moon and of the hunt. She was slain by Kuldra. A dark time for our people.
KeysToEntries.TribeB.Taskgiver2.MoonGoddess.3: Then, for a time, we wandered godless. We were alone, without the guidance we were so used to. That was until, one day, a child went missing in the sands.
KeysToEntries.TribeB.Taskgiver2.MoonGoddess.4: She was found, resting in an oasis that hadn't been there until that day, listening to the song of someone beautiful. Our histories tell us she was a garou, but the Forbidden Scroll says that she looked more like a human!
KeysToEntries.TribeB.Taskgiver2.MoonGoddess.5: Fascinating, yes? She called herself the goddess of the river, a moon deity that had left her old kingdom behind. In us she saw a people in need and she lifted us out of the dirt and into the dunes.
KeysToEntries.TribeB.Taskgiver2.MoonGoddess.6: She taught us architecture and agriculture, and she gave us the mirrors to protect us from supernatural threats.
KeysToEntries.TribeB.Taskgiver2.MoonGoddess.7: The Forbidden Scroll says that once she had helped us build our civilisation, she left this world for the stars - in search, perhaps, of some new souls in need of her guiding light. Can that really be the truth?
KeysToEntries.TribeB.Taskgiver2.MoonGoddess.8: She was not called El-Idahn-Inees, as our histories tell us. She was Elidinis: the mother of the Moon Garou.
KeysToEntries.TribeB.Taskgiver2.SunDemon.1: This Forbidden Scroll is fascinating. Our histories have reference of a Sun Demon, but they assume she arrived many thousands of years ago. But the Scrolls say that she arrives just after Fuzan.
KeysToEntries.TribeB.Taskgiver2.SunDemon.2: The Scroll also says that she entrances people somehow, changing who they are and turning them into devout worshippers of the sun - sometimes of flame, depending on the story.
KeysToEntries.TribeB.Taskgiver2.ScrollResponse.1: This Forbidden Scroll contains an alternate version of what really happened between Lougrim and Kuldra.
KeysToEntries.TribeB.Taskgiver2.SunDemon.4: She never seems to kill her victims. Indeed, the Forbidden Scroll implies that the subject lives a happy life in some sort of religious ecstasy. Their entire purpose in life is one of praise and adoration.
KeysToEntries.TribeB.Taskgiver2.SunDemon.5: Often those afflicted end up immolating themselves in some way. Horrifying, I know. They seek ways to burn themselves up, perhaps as some sort of sacrifice?
KeysToEntries.TribeB.Taskgiver2.SunDemon.6: I suppose the moral is that curiosity must always be paired with caution, lest you might lose yourself in the discovery.
KeysToEntries.TribeB.Taskgiver2.OldKingdom.1: To call it the Old Kingdom is perhaps a misnomer, for it is far more recent than our Ghornfell settlements. Nicer though... by a lot.
KeysToEntries.TribeB.Taskgiver2.OldKingdom.2: The Forbidden Scrolls confirm that the early Moon Garou were found travelling by a river goddess, who taught them culture and craft, so that they might move from settlements to cities.
KeysToEntries.TribeB.Taskgiver2.OldKingdom.3: And these cities were giant. They had stone walls and colourful tapestries, dangling across streets to shield people from the sands.
KeysToEntries.TribeB.Taskgiver2.OldKingdom.4: There were libraries filled with scrolls, full of the ancient words of our people. Festivals of colour, light, food and song.
KeysToEntries.TribeB.Taskgiver2.OldKingdom.5: We put aside the need for the hunt, and found ways to enrich ourselves with art, sciences and magic. It was a golden age for my people.
KeysToEntries.TribeB.Taskgiver2.OldKingdom.6: We were told that this civilisation became lost over time. But the scroll tells us it is a lie! Fuzan tore it down. He turned the very sun against us, so that we could no longer find comfort in the cities we had forged!
KeysToEntries.Elder1.TasksComplete.5: No doubt you will use it on your next step. If you wish to complete the Mirror Relay here, you will need the Mirror Lenses of Uzzer to the east, and Manafem to the south.
KeysToEntries.TribeB.Taskgiver1.Intro.6: Take this book to note down the passages. And remember: four rocky spires, each at the corners of the pyramid. Good luck!
KeysToEntries.TribeB.Taskgiver.Return.1: Ah, it is my Partner in Adventure! How goes the treasure-hunting?
KeysToEntries.TribeB.Taskgiver.Return.2: The passages are laid out in the Saga in your inventory, but I would be happy to repeat them now.
KeysToEntries.TribeB.Taskgiver1.Complete.1: Well done on finishing the saga! I will enjoy performing it at Fuzan's Mark Day.
KeysToEntries.TribeB.Taskgiver1.Complete.3: Feel free to unlock and explore the gateway at your own leisure. Meanwhile, I will sing your praises to the Elder.

KeysToEntries.SongAncients.Book.4:
Collect lyrics, which are etched onto statues within the pyramid-looking Vault to the south of Manafem.

"Five cradles stood empty on that baleful night,
A monster claimed them, and then took flight.
It left no footprints or scent on the air,
All the garou could follow was a thread of despair.

A shaman journeyed on the garous’ behalf.
Moon sprites twinkling on his adamant staff.
Kalphite skittered with a twist of his wrist.
Till the monster approached. “Shaman, desist.”

“A staff will not kill me. Ha - it’ll take more than that!
I have something to trade for your five little cats.
Their young minds are worthless. I need something older.
I’ll take what’s in your hand, and what's on your shoulder.”

The shaman returned with five cubs in a sled.
But there was no staff in his hand,
And no thoughts in his head."

KeysToEntries.Scout.Evidence.2: This must be one of Hedric's lost scouts. The poor garou has been torched completely.
KeysToEntries.Scout.Evidence.3: There are no blades or arrows here. The corpse reeks of the familiar smell of sulphur.
KeysToEntries.Scout2.Evidence.1: A garou lies dead here, covered in blood.
KeysToEntries.Scout2.Evidence.2: A garou lies here, its fur matted with blood. There is something large and white embedded in its back.
KeysToEntries.Scout2.Evidence.3: It's a tooth. An extremely large tooth.

KeysToEntries.ScorchMarks.Evidence.3: While large, the blast is lesser than that of Fuzan. Whatever did this is smaller, but not that much smaller.
